title: Reckoner
description: Private-bank calm: a warm linen page, white cards and sand hairlines, charcoal text, one deep merlot band, sand buttons that turn merlot on hover, camel for faded heading tails and crimson used sparingly. Square corners, no shadows, Mona Sans throughout.
notes: light is the faithful mode; .dark is the merlot world the hero and header wrap themselves in
--radius is 3px, so rounded-sm comes out square (as the original) and rounded-lg gives the 3px eyebrow square
Mona Sans is the original's own face (open licence); Geist, used for a few nav labels on the original, folds into it
